From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + request to align VP/CTO for exec intro

Samir — great conversation earlier. Quick recap from my side and a single ask to help unblock the next steps.

Summary of discovery (high level):
- Primary goal: reduce per-query inference cost for recommendation inference while keeping 99th percentile latency under 120ms.
- Current constraints: mixed traffic (batch + tail-heavy real-time), existing infra on GCP us-west, strict PCI scope for checkout calls.
- Success signals: cost per 1M requests, latency SLO adherence, and ability to run A/B experiments without significant infra changes.

What I recommend next: a short executive alignment call (VP/CTO level) to confirm risk-tolerance and success metrics, followed by a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with your engineering team. If the exec call lands well, we can schedule the technical deep dive for the week after.

Proposed VP/CTO intro slots (PT):
- Wed 11/04, 10:00–10:30
- Thu 11/05, 15:00–15:30
- Fri 11/06, 09:30–10:00

Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that outlines milestones we typically follow — helps speed approval and procurement later. Also included a one-pager on our production guarantees.

Ask: could you loop in the person on your side who can speak to platform constraints (I think Evelyn is your CTO?) and let me know which slot works? I can send a calendar invite and a short pre-read (5–7 slides).

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Samir — perfect, thanks. Evelyn — welcome. I’ve looped in Lauren (my manager) and Vivek (solutions engineering) so we have the right folks on the call. Below are the short pre-read items you requested.

Pre-read (one-liners):
- Risk & rollback: we support pinned model variants + traffic splitting; if any regression occurs we can route traffic to a shadow variant or fall back to a quantized CPU variant within minutes.
- PCI & scoped inference: we recommend isolating checkout-related tokens to a private deployment (VPC) and integrating with your KMS; we have an off-the-shelf compliance checklist for PCI scopes. Example customer: ShopWave reduced costs by 32% while keeping checkout calls on a private VPC.

Confirmed slots (PT): per Samir’s availability, propose Wed 11/04 10:00–10:30 for the VP/CTO alignment. If that works for Evelyn, we’ll send a calendar invite for 30 minutes and reserve a separate 90-minute technical deep dive slot the following week.

I attached the MAP again and a short product one-pager. Vivek — if possible, can you prepare a 2-slide architecture snapshot (90 seconds each) that we can include in the exec call? No deep technical minutiae — just deployment options and security guardrails.

Next steps:
1) Evelyn confirms the slot — Dylan will send invite and pre-read.
2) If confirmed, schedule the 90-minute technical deep dive (preferably Fri 11/13 or Mon 11/16).
3) Share procurement timeline items if any (Samir, feel free to add).

Thanks all — sending the invite once Evelyn confirms.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
